component: P16 published edge UNKNOWN conformance tests
constraints: Offline comparison of one published OpenAPI 3.1.1 schema/fixture pair and six exact-byte authentication cases.
Structural validation must be independent of producer model validation; external reference retrieval is denied. Scene milliseconds and UTC seconds remain separate.
alternatives: Python unittest direct API tests with portable JSON fixtures; jsonschema plus an explicit reference registry for structural checks.
JavaScript/TypeScript Node test runner and Ajv draft-2020-12 for portable structural validation.
Java/Kotlin JUnit with a process or foreign-function adapter to the actual Python APIs.
Robot Framework keyword-driven acceptance tests backed by Python libraries.
Rust proptest for generated contract cases with a process or foreign-function adapter.
rationale: KEEP direct unittest plus jsonschema: independently interpret the published structural schema, then call the actual verifier without an IPC result translation layer.

Ajv supplies a credible second draft-2020-12 implementation and would help independent cross-runtime differential validation. The present requirement is a fixed consumer check against the producer schema and actual verifier; neither schema engine alone verifies signatures or clock provenance.

JUnit and Robot Framework provide test orchestration but do not add producer-independent semantics to these API checks. Rust proptest serves generated property exploration rather than the fixed six-case inventory.
Three existing methods pass. Two wrapped-result sensitivity experiments produce twelve expected assertion failures with no errors or skips. No new mismatch demonstrated.
limits: This decision concerns offline conformance tests, not the implementation language of a peer-owned decoder or a future transport.
No alternative performance benchmark or language ranking. No throughput or hard-real-time requirement is assigned to this fixed local corpus.
Source digests and module paths are not loaded-bytecode attestation, atomic snapshots or complete dependency closure.
No physical, ROS/DDS, MLS/CNSA, tactical, availability or whole-product qualification.
